column1: # Scenario lines for scene 61001401 (Sirius Sugar rooftop episode)

column2: I wander up to the rooftop on a whim, and――
Haah... the breeze feels so nice...<LF>I feel like I could sleep soundly here...
Taking a nap out here?
Hmm? I had a shift at the beef bowl place until late yesterday...<LF>So I'm getting less sleep than usual.
Class has been rough lately, honestly...<LF>I figured if I'm going to doze off anyway, I'd rather nap here than in the classroom.
Then I'll nap with you!<LF>They say a good nap is healthy for you, after all.
Huh? Why are you next to Rami...?
Come on, it's fine.<LF>It'd be weird to sleep together while keeping our distance, right?
And for starters, I never said you could sleep with me.<LF>At least stay 100 meters away.
Wouldn't I fall off and sleep for eternity, then?
It's fine, you'd sleep soundly――hey, don't force your way next to me!<LF>If someone else saw us, they'd get the wrong idea, wouldn't they!?
Zzz... Zzz...
...Wait, huh... he's already asleep... That was way too fast.
...Well, I suppose a little is fine.<LF>I'll use him as a pillow.
And so, the two of us slept soundly together on the rooftop.
Nothing beats sleep for shaking off fatigue!<LF>I'll help you get a good night's rest.
Ha...? Help with what?<LF>I can sleep fine on my own, though...
How about a lullaby!
No... a deep voice like that singing a lullaby would just keep me awake...<LF>Besides, I'm sleepy, so can we stop...?
............Lap pillow, please. The concrete looks hard.
Haha, got it.
